pages.title: Cyclone Ditwah — red alert for Tirupati, Prakasam, Nellore

facts.text: Date: 30 November 2025 — Red Alert for Tirupati, Prakasam and Nellore districts
facts.head: News

facts.text: System: Cyclone Ditwah over the Bay of Bengal; expected to weaken into a depression
facts.head: News

facts.text: Track: moving parallel to the Tamil Nadu–Puducherry coast — reduced landfall risk
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Ditwah did not make landfall near Puducherry
facts.head: News

facts.text: Winds: squally 45–55 kmph, gusting up to 65 kmph; later 35–45 kmph gusting 55 kmph
facts.head: News

facts.text: Fishermen: barred from sea till December 2
facts.head: News

facts.text: Alert: Red Alert; Districts: Tirupati, Prakasam, Nellore
facts.head: Heavy rainfall districts (AP)

facts.text: Alert: Heavy rainfall; Districts: YSR Kadapa, Annamayya, Bapatla, Chittoor, Sri Sathya Sai, Anantapur, Nandyal, Palnadu, Guntur, Krishna, West Godavari, Konaseema
facts.head: Heavy rainfall districts (AP)

facts.text: AP response: district control rooms activated; emergency teams on standby
facts.head: Heavy rainfall districts (AP)

pages.title: Aravalli range — SC uniform 100-m definition and mining pause

facts.text: Supreme Court (November 2025): adopted a uniform definition — only hills above 100 m elevation are Aravallis; paused all fresh mining leases in Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, Gujarat
facts.head: News

facts.text: Direction: prepare a Management Plan for Sustainable Mining (MPSM) for the entire range
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Concern: 100-m rule excludes 90%+ of the landscape
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ No total ban — total bans fuel illegal mining
facts.head: News

facts.text: Age: nearly two billion years — India's oldest range (⚠ an old UPSC 2001 key gives 370 million years)
facts.head: Aravalli facts

facts.text: Length: 650 km, Delhi to Gujarat
facts.head: Aravalli facts

facts.text: Highest peak: Guru Shikhar (1,722 m), Mount Abu, Rajasthan — ⚠ not Gujarat
facts.head: Aravalli facts

facts.text: Rivers: Banas, Sahibi, Luni (to Rann of Kutch); also linked to Chambal, Sabarmati
facts.head: Aravalli facts

facts.text: Groundwater: fell to 1,000–2,000 feet in Mahendergarh
facts.head: Aravalli facts

facts.text: Year: 2009; Action: SC ban on mining in Gurugram, Faridabad, Mewat
facts.head: Protection timeline

facts.text: Year: 2024 (May); Action: Halt on new mining leases
facts.head: Protection timeline

facts.text: Year: 2024; Action: Central Empowered Committee (CEC) recommendations
facts.head: Protection timeline

facts.text: Year: 2025; Action: Aravalli Green Wall Project — 5-km green buffer in 29 districts of four States
facts.head: Protection timeline

facts.text: Year: 2025 (Nov); Action: Uniform 100-m definition
facts.head: Protection timeline

facts.text: Land restoration goal: 26 million hectares by 2030 (UNCCD)
facts.head: Protection timeline

pages.title: Methane emissions from landfills — satellite evidence

facts.text: Satellite data: methane from Indian landfills far higher than official estimates; globally landfill emissions up to 1.8 times model estimates
facts.head: News

facts.text: India: third-largest methane emitter (after China, USA); 31 million tonnes/year (about 9% of global)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Waste sector: about 15% of India's methane
facts.head: News

facts.text: 3rd Biennial Update Report (2016): methane 409 million tonnes CO₂e (excl. LULUCF)
facts.head: News

facts.text: CH₄: simplest alkane; 80–95% of natural gas; lighter than air
facts.head: Methane facts

facts.text: GWP: 84× CO₂ over 20 years; 28–34× over 100 years
facts.head: Methane facts

facts.text: Platforms: ISRO (2023 study), CarbonMapper – Tanager, SRON, ClimateTRACE, WasteMap
facts.head: Methane facts

facts.text: City: Ahmedabad; Landfill: Pirana
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

facts.text: City: Mumbai; Landfill: Deonar, Kanjurmarg (10× model estimates)
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

facts.text: City: Delhi; Landfill: Ghazipur, Bhalswa
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

facts.text: City: Hyderabad; Landfill: Jawaharnagar
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

facts.text: City: Kolkata; Landfill: Dhapa
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

facts.text: Example of capture: Indore's Bio-CNG plant under GOBARdhan
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

facts.text: Methane hydrate: found in Arctic tundra and under sea floor; methane oxidises to CO₂ in a decade or two
facts.head: Landfill hotspots

pages.title: Indoor air pollution and air-purifying plants

facts.text: Finding: indoor air can be 2.5 times more polluted than outdoor, up to 100 times in extreme cases
facts.head: News

facts.text: Burden: indoor pollution linked to 4.1% of global deaths annually
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ India has no uniform Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) protocol
facts.head: News

facts.text: Deaths: 3.2 million per year; 86 million healthy life years lost (2019 DALYs)
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Cause of HAP deaths: Ischaemic heart disease; Share: 32%
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Cause of HAP deaths: Stroke; Share: 23%
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Cause of HAP deaths: Lower respiratory infections; Share: 21%
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Cause of HAP deaths: COPD; Share: 19%
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Cause of HAP deaths: Lung cancer; Share: 6%
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Children under 5: 44% of pneumonia deaths linked to HAP
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: COPD: progressive, irreversible; leading cause tobacco smoking; confirmed by spirometry
facts.head: WHO data — household air pollution

facts.text: Clean cooking: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) for LPG; traditional stoves emit black carbon and methane (SLCPs)
facts.head: Air-purifying plants

facts.text: Bioremediation: use of bacteria, fungi, algae, plants to break down pollutants into non-toxic by-products (water, CO₂, organic acids)
facts.head: Concept

facts.text: Type: In situ; Meaning: Clean on the spot; Example: Oil-eating bacteria sprayed on ocean spill
facts.head: Concept

facts.text: Type: Ex situ; Meaning: Remove, treat in facility, return; Example: Soil washing for pesticide farmland
facts.head: Concept

facts.text: ⚠ Heavy metals (cadmium, lead) cannot be completely degraded — only transformed/immobilised (UPSC 2017)
facts.head: Concept

facts.text: GM microbes can be engineered for bioremediation
facts.head: Concept

facts.text: DBT Clean Technology Programme; CSIR–NEERI projects
facts.head: India's efforts

facts.text: IIT: cotton-based nanocomposite mats to mop up oil spills
facts.head: India's efforts

facts.text: Firms: BCIL, Econirmal Biotech
facts.head: India's efforts

facts.text: Gaps: no unified national bioremediation standards; no biosafety rules for GM microbes
facts.head: India's efforts

facts.text: Abroad: China uses GM bacteria under its soil pollution law; Japan integrates into city waste systems
facts.head: India's efforts
